title: Cryptocurrency & Blockchain Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Assess your crypto privacy risks with our calculator. Evaluate transaction anonymity, blockchain exposure, and improve your cryptocurrency privacy.
description: Evaluate your cryptocurrency privacy risks across different blockchains and transaction methods. Get personalized recommendations to enhance your crypto anonymity and protect your financial privacy from blockchain analysis.

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your cryptocurrency privacy risks by analyzing blockchain transparency, transaction patterns, exchange usage, and privacy practices. It considers the inherent privacy features of different cryptocurrencies, your behavioral patterns, and the tools you use to protect your financial privacy.
tips: Use privacy-focused cryptocurrencies like Monero or Zcash for better anonymity
Never reuse cryptocurrency addresses - generate a new address for each transaction
Use Incognito Browser or Tor when accessing cryptocurrency services
Prefer decentralized exchanges (DEX) over centralized KYC exchanges when possible
Consider using mixing services or privacy tools for Bitcoin transactions
Avoid sharing cryptocurrency addresses on social media or public forums
Use a VPN when conducting cryptocurrency transactions
Keep separate wallets for different purposes (trading, long-term storage, privacy)

interpretation.label: Excellent Privacy (A)
interpretation.description: You maintain strong cryptocurrency privacy with minimal exposure risks. Continue current practices.

interpretation.label: Good Privacy (B)
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices with some room for improvement. Consider additional privacy tools.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk (C)
interpretation.description: Moderate privacy risks present. Review address reuse habits and consider privacy coins.

interpretation.label: High Risk (D)
interpretation.description: Significant privacy vulnerabilities. Immediate improvements needed in multiple areas.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk (F)
interpretation.description: Critical privacy exposure. Your cryptocurrency activities are highly traceable and linkable.
